args.title: Allow uploads with quoted headers by adjusting message handling
args.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

Modify the error handling logic to correctly interpret headers that are fully quoted. This adjustment ensures the system does not mistakenly reject files where quotes are used correctly in headers, aligning with the intended flexibility for CSV uploads. The error message in `src/i18n/en.json` should support this correct interpretation and allow for the import of files with fully quoted headers.
